optimization_analysis: Two main optimizations: (1) Push all cheap relational filters (component match, event match, Aircraft-primary) into a structural pre-filter JOIN before any semantic operator, so LLM calls are made only on the small set of incidents that already pass all structured criteria rather than on the full Aircraft-primary corpus. (2) Collapse the two sequential SEM_FILTERs into one and merge SEM_EXTRACT with SEM_CLASSIFY into a single combined operator, reducing per-document LLM passes from four (2×SEM_FILTER + SEM_EXTRACT + SEM_CLASSIFY) to two (1×SEM_FILTER + 1×SEM_EXTRACT+CLASSIFY). The final SEM_AGGREGATE is cheap because it runs once per group, not per document, so it is left unchanged.

optimized_semantic_plan.program:
qualifying_incidents := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id, text_file, primary_problem])
  -> FILTER(primary_problem = 'Aircraft')
)
component_match := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, components.csv, [incident_id, attribute, value])
  -> FILTER(attribute = 'aircraft_component' AND (value CONTAINS 'Pressurization' OR value CONTAINS 'Pack' OR value CONTAINS 'Bleed' OR value CONTAINS 'Air Conditioning'))
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id], {component_records:COLLECT(value)})
)
event_match := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, events.csv, [incident_id, event_type, label])
  -> FILTER(label = 'Flight Deck / Cabin / Aircraft Event Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor' OR label CONTAINS 'Aircraft Equipment Problem')
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id], {event_labels:COLLECT(event_type, label)})
)
candidate_incidents := (
  JOIN(left=qualifying_incidents, right=component_match, join_type=inner, condition=qualifying_incidents.incident_id = component_match.incident_id)
  -> JOIN(right=event_match, join_type=inner, condition=incident_id = event_match.incident_id)
)
causal_records := (
  SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=candidate_incidents.text_file, [incident_id, text])
  -> SEM_FILTER("Keep reports whose narrative describes exactly one clearly primary cause for the smoke, fumes, odor, or equipment event AND an operational consequence beyond a maintenance-record entry alone.", {text})
  -> SEM_EXTRACT("Extract: (1) cause_category assigned to exactly one of equipment_malfunction | maintenance_or_release_decision | environmental_contamination | crew_procedure; (2) system_phrase describing the relevant system in at most six words; (3) operational_outcome describing the dominant operational consequence in at most six words.", {incident_id:string, cause_category:string, system_phrase:string, operational_outcome:string}, {incident_id, text})
)
joined := JOIN(left=causal_records, right=candidate_incidents, join_type=inner, condition=causal_records.incident_id = candidate_incidents.incident_id)
joined
-> GROUP_BY([cause_category], {incident_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(incident_id), causal_records:COLLECT(system_phrase, operational_outcome, component_records, event_labels)})
-> SEM_AGGREGATE("For each cause category, produce the canonical system and dominant operational outcome as phrases of at most six words.", {canonical_system:string, dominant_operational_outcome:string}, group_by=[cause_category], input_bindings={causal_records})
